headline: [SIMULATED] Flash flood alert issued for Pune district
snippet: IMD warns of 100-150 mm of rain in the next 6 hours. Khadakwasla dam discharge increasing; residents along the Mutha river urged to move to higher ground.

headline: [SIMULATED] Mutha river overtopping near Deccan and Sangamwadi
snippet: PMC officials report water levels rising rapidly along the Mutha river. Several roads closed near Lakdi Pul and Sangamwadi.

headline: [SIMULATED] PMPML suspends bus services on low-lying routes
snippet: Waterlogging at multiple stops forces suspension of services on Sinhagad Road and Deccan routes until further notice.

headline: [SIMULATED] PMC opens relief shelters at municipal schools
snippet: Emergency shelters now accepting evacuees in Kothrud and Shivajinagar. Bring medications and identification.

headline: [SIMULATED] Pune hospitals on emergency footing
snippet: Major hospitals including Sassoon and Ruby Hall report a surge in flood-related injuries. Non-critical procedures postponed.

headline: [SIMULATED] Sinhagad Road underpass flooded - avoid area
snippet: Pune Traffic Police confirm multiple lanes underwater near Vitthalwadi. Rescue crews deploying high-water vehicles.
